executive_summary: Maven build failed due to a compilation error in TaskManagementController.java. The controller is calling getUserTasks() with a Pageable parameter, but the TaskService interface expects two int parameters (page and size). This is a method signature mismatch that requires updating either the service interface to accept Pageable or the controller to extract page/size from Pageable.

errors.message: method getUserTasks cannot be applied to given types; required: Long,int,int found: Long,Pageable
errors.root_cause: The TaskManagementController is calling taskService.getUserTasks() with parameters (Long userId, Pageable pageable), but the TaskService interface defines getUserTasks() with signature (Long userId, int page, int size). This is a method signature mismatch between the controller and service interface.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update TaskService.getUserTasks() method signature to accept Pageable instead of separate int parameters: 'Page<TaskDTO> getUserTasks(Long userId, Pageable pageable)'. Then update the implementation class TaskServiceImpl to match this signature and use pageable.getPageNumber() and pageable.getPageSize() internally.
